pages.title: Jelly Yeet!
pages.creator: merlinis
pages.description: Send a bouncing jelly on a long-distance flight in Jelly Yeet! Stop the launch meter with a click, tap, or Space press, aiming for its strongest zone. Once airborne, you have one slam to use during that launch. Trampolines, springy objects, and portals help carry the jelly farther. Spend earned coins on power, bounce, and slam upgrades, and unlock different jelly skins and clubs while pursuing a new distance record.

pages.title: Biblox Online
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Explore three different activities in Biblox Online. Mini Obby offers obstacle courses to jump through, while Speed Simulator lets you gather speed particles and make your character faster. In Color Tycoon, buy upgrades for your base, obtain items, and develop a larger building. Use WASD to move and Space to jump on a computer, or use the on-screen movement buttons on a phone.

pages.title: Prison Break
pages.creator: Square Dino LLC
pages.description:
Build up a prison and stop its inmates escaping in Prison Break. During each day, improve the block, construct fortifications, hire staff, and purchase upgrades. At day's end, fight the escaping prisoners and return them to confinement so you can continue. Later days introduce more challenges and bosses, with several prisons to manage.

Move with WASD, the arrows, or a held mouse drag; touch dragging also controls the character. Shooting happens automatically, and standing on an activity's location lets you interact with it.

pages.title: Dusty Cat
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Grow a speck of dust into a cat in Dusty Cat. Eat smaller dust particles while keeping away from larger enemies, progressing through the character's different growth phases. The points you collect contribute to a score you can compare on the leaderboard. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys on a computer; on a touchscreen, keep a finger down and swipe to change direction.

pages.title: Dart Hero
pages.creator: Hyper Rabbit Games
pages.description: Dart Hero turns dart throwing into a timing challenge. Wait for the right moment, then tap to take the shot. The controls focus on a single action, so your task is to judge when to fire as you continue playing.

pages.title: Fish rain 2
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Cast a line and reel in different fish in Fish rain 2. Click the hook button to cast, wait for the float to sink, then press it again to set the hook. Click the screen to pull the fish in while keeping the fishing gauge around its middle range.

Choose among fishing locations, including a rocky shore and the Pripyat River, and try baits such as worms, leeches, or live bait. Possible catches include pike, catfish, carp, and sturgeon, with the catch's species and weight giving you something to share with other players.

pages.title: Cargo Path Puzzle
pages.creator: Mirgo Games
pages.description: Collect every key and reach the exit portal in Cargo Path Puzzle. Plan a route through collapsing tiles, slippery ice, trampolines, directional blocks, and gaps. A poor move can leave you trapped or close the route you need, so the order of your movements matters. Use WASD or the arrows to move. Space jumps in the direction of your last move, skipping a tile; gather all the keys to unlock the portal before stepping onto it.

pages.title: Squid Game: Craft Runner
pages.creator: Todos For Games
pages.description: Run along block-built railway tracks in Squid Game: Craft Runner. Choose a character, then jump and dodge to get past obstacles and traps along the subway route. The setting combines Squid Game-inspired characters with a cubic world. Keep the runner clear of the hazards while working through the challenges ahead.

pages.title: Candy Doll Dress Up
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Create a princess doll's look in Candy Doll Dress Up. Choose her hairstyle and dress her in clothing from the available styles, building the character's appearance from the beginning. Click or tap to make your selections and compare how the different pieces look together. The activity centers on customizing the doll and putting together an outfit of your own.

pages.title: Bank Robbery: Escape
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Break your crew out of a guarded police station in Bank Robbery: Escape. This first-person shooter sends you through police resistance while a time limit pressures the escape. Equip your weapons and fight a way through the station. Move with WASD, shoot with the left mouse button, and use right-click to aim down the sights. The mouse wheel changes weapons, Left Shift runs, Space jumps, and E interacts.

pages.title: Tunnel Road
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Dodge through a fast-moving tunnel in Tunnel Road. Shift left and right to avoid the obstacles ahead, aiming to survive longer and raise your score. Choose solo or two-player mode before starting. Player one can use A and D, while player two uses the left and right arrows; those arrows also work for a solo player. Touch controls provide another way to steer.

pages.title: Zumble Story
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Shoot matching marbles through jungle-themed challenges in Zumble Story. Aim to connect at least three marbles of one color and clear the group. Depending on the level, you need to remove the marbles entering play or finish within a time limit. Bomb, Laser, and Rainbow boosters offer extra help as you tackle obstacles and unlock more chapters of the journey.

pages.title: Army Commander Craft
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Build and improve a fighting force in Army Commander Craft. Take the commander's role, developing your army before leading it into shooting battles against enemy units. Your objective is to defeat the opposing force through the army you build and the way you direct it in combat. Use mouse clicks or taps to interact.

pages.title: Football Penalty
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Aim penalty shots at targets in Football Penalty. Earn points for accurate hits while keeping the ball clear of obstacles such as cones and boxes. The penalty duels continue as you progress through levels, and trophies can unlock new balls. A separate tournament offers further rewards, adding another competition to the target-shooting challenge.

pages.title: Fun Golf
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Line up golf shots in Fun Golf, a two-dimensional course game about getting the ball into the hole. Touch the ball and drag to set the aiming line, then release to send it across the course. Walls and other obstacles change the route available to the cup. Complete the hole to move on to another course.

pages.title: Skyscraper to the Sky
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Connect building floors into a rising tower in Skyscraper to the Sky. Place each section with care: an unstable arrangement can bring the structure down. The game contains 30 levels, moving from small houses toward much larger buildings. Your task is to gain height while keeping the construction stable, making the position of each new floor part of the puzzle.

pages.title: Only Up Or Lava
pages.creator: Nexus
pages.description: Climb through obstacle courses above dangerous lava in Only Up Or Lava. Jump between surfaces and work through increasingly difficult levels without dropping into the molten hazard below. WASD moves the character, while Space handles jumping and climbing. Press R to open the pause menu. The challenge centers on precise movement as you make your way over each course's obstacles.

pages.title: Kick the President
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Experiment with a cartoon arsenal in Kick the President. Use the mouse or touch controls to direct attacks at the presidential character, choosing effects such as shooting, explosions, fire, and freezing. The available equipment includes rockets, grenades, automatic rifles, a metal bar, and a flamethrower. The game focuses on trying these different attacks against its fictional target.

pages.title: Do Dragons Exist
pages.creator: HolaStudio
pages.description: Begin as a small tadpole and eat your way toward stronger forms in Do Dragons Exist. Touch and hold to move through the battlefield, devouring enemies to evolve while staying away from opponents that are too powerful. Growth changes what you can take on as you pursue the game's dragon transformation. Survival depends on choosing targets your current creature can handle.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Candy
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear a candy-colored bubble board in Bubble Shooter Candy. Move the mouse cursor or a finger to aim, then click or tap to fire toward bubbles of the same color. Matching colors removes bubbles and earns points, with the goal of emptying the board to finish the level. Choose a firing direction that brings the next shot into contact with a matching group.

pages.title: City Car Parking 3D
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Complete vehicle tasks and develop a customized car in City Car Parking 3D. Fuel and damage systems add vehicle management to the driving, while your completed assignments contribute to customization. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys, press F to activate nitro, and use R if the car becomes stuck. The simulation combines handling the vehicle with customizing it as you progress.

pages.title: Biomons Mart.
pages.creator: Devshifu Studio
pages.description: Build and expand a pet shop in Biomons Mart. Care for animals including puppies, kittens, and birds while managing the shop's growth. Click or tap to collect cash, buy upgrades, and unlock more of the business. The pet-care setting is paired with shop expansion, giving you both animals to look after and new improvements to work toward.

pages.title: Perfect Brain 3D
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: Rearrange matchsticks to fix equations in Perfect Brain 3D. The numbers are built from individual matches, so changing their arrangement changes the arithmetic shown on screen. Work out which matches need adjusting to make the equation correct. Puzzles grow more difficult as you progress, and hints are available at each level when you need help finding the solution.

pages.title: Demolish Derby
pages.creator: Simplicity Games
pages.description: Demolish Derby puts you behind the wheel in a contest of car collisions. Click and drag to steer, lining up the front of your car with rival vehicles to attack and destroy them. The garage offers skins to unlock as you play, giving your demolition car a different look for later contests.

pages.title: Tomb of the Mark 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Scale a procedurally generated vertical maze in Tomb of the Mark 2. A mysterious mask gives the tomb explorer the ability to climb walls quickly, but traps and enemies stand along the upward route. Seek power-ups while navigating the maze's hazards. Move with the arrow keys on a computer or use the game's on-screen movement buttons on a touchscreen.

pages.title: Robot Butcher
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Defend a human outpost from hostile machines in Robot Butcher. You control the resistance's robot fighter in a two-dimensional arena shooter, battling an army of robots that has turned against humanity. Use WASD to move and jump, and handle aiming and shooting with the mouse. Keep the Robo-butcher moving through the fight while directing its fire at the attacking robots.

pages.title: Real Construction Excavator Simulator
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description:
Load, transport, and unload building materials in Real Construction Excavator Simulator. Start by using an excavator to fill the truck, then drive the cargo over challenging terrain to the construction site. Careless driving can cost you part of the load. Finish the delivery by dumping the materials in the designated area.

WASD or the arrow keys drive the truck, Space applies its handbrake, and E dumps the cargo. Press F to switch vehicles. In the excavator, E changes between driving and digging modes, bringing a different set of machine controls into the loading task.

pages.title: Bff Witchy Transformation
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Give a group of princess friends a change of style in Bff Witchy Transformation. Bored with their usual weekend plans, they decide to try witch-inspired costumes. Use the left mouse button to make the clothing selections and put together their darker themed looks. The activity follows the friends' costume makeover as they try something different from their everyday princess outfits.

pages.title: Chess Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Arrange a game with friends through the lobby in Chess Multi player. This multiplayer version brings classic chess to a shared board, where you take turns moving pieces and try to checkmate the opposing king. Plan attacks while protecting your own position, using each piece's movement to support the others. The lobby provides the starting point for playing a match together.

pages.title: Fish & Trip Online
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Lead a small fish through a dangerous ocean in Fish & Trip Online. Gather food and recruit companions of the same species while keeping the group away from predators and hazardous objects. Use the mouse to guide the fish on a computer, or touch and slide on a touchscreen. Your search for food and friends continues alongside the need to keep clear of threats.

pages.title: Cute Puzzle
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put cartoon animal pictures back together in Cute Puzzle. Drag each image fragment into its correct position, comparing the pieces with the picture you are assembling. Nine levels make up the complete game, with another animal puzzle to finish as you progress. Use the mouse or touch controls to move the pieces and restore each illustration.

pages.title: forth test
pages.creator: test User name lastname
pages.description: Draw lines to guide balls into baskets in forth test. Drag across the play area to create physical surfaces that redirect the moving balls toward their targets. You have a limited supply of lines, and unused lines increase the points earned for a successful catch. Get every ball into a basket to continue, shaping each path so the ball reaches the opening.

pages.title: ABC game
pages.creator: nau.kids
pages.description: Connect pictures with words in ABC game. Look at the image and click the correct answer to work through the word-learning activity. The illustrations provide the clues, keeping each question focused on recognizing what is shown and choosing a matching response. Use the picture to decide on your selection as the game introduces different words.

pages.title: Samurai Rampage
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slash approaching demons before they reach your samurai in Samurai Rampage. Tap to attack, combining different strikes to build combos and increase your score. Boss encounters add tougher opponents to the fighting. The challenge is to keep reacting to the enemies coming toward you while turning successful attacks into a stronger scoring sequence.

pages.title: Rope Bawling
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Release bowling balls by cutting their ropes in Rope Bawling. The aim is to knock down the pins, but hanging boxes and moving platforms complicate the route. Study how the objects are positioned before making a cut, then use the ball's movement to reach the skittles. Mouse or touch controls let you choose which rope to sever.

pages.title: Parkour Block 3D
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Run and jump through 35 courses in Parkour Block 3D. The block-based stages test your movement and landing as you work through their different platforming arrangements. Use WASD to move, Space to jump, and Left Shift to run. Press Escape twice to open the menu. Touch controls are also available for handling the jumps and movement on a touchscreen.

pages.title: Stickdoll : God Of Archery
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description:
Gather equipment before a turn-based bow duel in Stickdoll : God Of Archery. Collect armor, arrows, and random item bubbles, keeping in mind that a bubble may have an unwanted effect. Then enter the arena and take turns firing the arrows you gathered. If the contest lasts three rounds, the fighter with more health wins.

Play against the computer or a friend. Player one moves with WASD and shoots with Space; player two uses the arrow keys and K. Set the power bar before firing to control the shot.

pages.title: Popsy Princess Delicious Fashion
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Build outfits around favorite foods in Popsy Princess Delicious Fashion. Create a look inspired by fruit, sushi, or fast food, starting with makeup and a hairstyle with accessories. Choose a dress or combine a top with a skirt, then add shoes to complete the food-themed styling challenge. Use the left mouse button or touch controls to make each fashion selection.

pages.title: Galactic War
pages.creator: FK
pages.description: Pilot a ship through arcade space combat in Galactic War. Fire at enemies while steering clear of the projectiles and other threats crossing your path. The game uses a retro shoot-'em-up style, combining ship movement with bullet-hell action. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and use the mouse for the other actions as you fight through the opposition.

pages.title: Chess Move
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Capture a stationary enemy king in Chess Move, a puzzle platformer built around chess-piece movement. Each piece follows its usual move pattern, but gravity makes it fall afterward, and it cannot move again until it lands. Plan around one-way platforms, locked doors, keys, and buttons across 24 levels. Reaching the king requires combining legal chess moves with the layout's platforming obstacles.

pages.title: Mars V Jupiter
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Challenge a second player to a planetary drinking contest in Mars V Jupiter. Each player controls a planet and tries to make it drink more water than its rival. Mars uses A, S, and D, while Jupiter uses J, K, and L, so both players can compete on the same keyboard. Work the assigned keys to help your planet outdrink the other side.

pages.title: Maze Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Find a route from the red square to the blue square in Maze Challenge. Move through the maze's passages and work out which turns lead toward the destination. The game generates its layouts randomly, providing more mazes to explore after each attempt. Follow the corridors carefully and check how the routes connect as you guide the red square to its goal.

pages.title: Stick Duel : Medieval Wars
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Trade medieval weapon blows with a friend in Stick Duel : Medieval Wars. Move your stick fighter horizontally to bring its weapon into contact with the opponent and compete for stars in the overall score. The left player uses A and D, while the right player uses the left and right arrow keys. Touch controls provide another way to move the fighters during the duel.

pages.title: Arkadium's Holiday Mahjong Dimensions
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Match festive tiles against the clock in Arkadium's Holiday Mahjong Dimensions. Select available pairs bearing identical symbols and work toward clearing every set before time expires. The levels replace traditional tile imagery with Christmas trees, lights, ornaments, and other seasonal designs, accompanied by Christmas music. Look through the arrangement for the next selectable pair as you work through each holiday puzzle.

pages.title: Kiss Match
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Swap kiss symbols to make matching lines in Kiss Match. Select neighboring pieces with a click or touch and arrange at least three matching symbols in a row or column to clear them. Build your score while gathering coins and gems, then compare the result with your best score. Check both directions for matches before choosing which pieces to exchange.

pages.title: Prison Escape Game
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Help an innocent prisoner prepare a jailbreak in Prison Escape Game. Jack needs to plan his route and make tools for drilling through the prison wall, working carefully around the security guard. Follow the instructions shown on screen to carry out the escape activities. Act quickly when the situation calls for it, since attracting the guard's attention can end the attempt.

pages.title: Penguin Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Piece together six penguin pictures in Penguin Jigsaw. Begin with the first image and complete it to unlock the next puzzle. Each picture offers three sizes: Easy uses 25 pieces, Medium has 49, and Hard contains 100. Use mouse or touch controls to assemble the scene, choosing a piece count that suits the amount of detail you want to work through.

pages.title: Soviet Cars Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Restore pictures of Soviet-era cars in Soviet Cars Jigsaw. Use the mouse or touchscreen to drag the scattered pieces into place, joining the sections until the vehicle image is complete. Compare the shapes and details across the pieces as you rebuild the picture. The challenge is to finish the car puzzle as quickly as you can.

pages.title: Love Pins
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Remove obstacles to reunite a couple in Love Pins. Click or tap the pins to open routes through the puzzle, choosing the order carefully so the lovers can meet. Hostile characters also block their date, and tools in the scene can be used against them. Study what each pin is holding back before releasing it and changing the route.

pages.title: Fruit Cutter
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Slice the incoming produce for points in Fruit Cutter. Use the mouse to cut fruit while it is still in the air, before it reaches the floor. Bombs appear among the targets and need to be avoided. Watch what is entering the scene so you can keep cutting the fruit without catching a bomb in the same movement.

pages.title: Granny Horror
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Search for escape items while a nearby pursuer threatens you in Granny Horror. You are trapped in a jungle and must collect the objects needed to complete the level. Move carefully, since your actions can attract Granny and put the escape at risk. Use the keyboard and on-screen controls to explore while working through the current objective.

pages.title: Puppet Hockey Battle
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Play a one-on-one ice-hockey contest in Puppet Hockey Battle. Choose from 12 international teams and use your player's stick to send the puck into the opposing net. Protect your own goal while looking for an opening to shoot. The keyboard controls use the arrows and F to fire a shot, with touchscreen controls also available.

pages.title: Buddy Blast Physic Puzzle Game
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description:
Get a ragdoll off the screen by setting the scene's objects in motion in Buddy Blast Physic Puzzle Game. Across 70 levels, balls, obstacles, and tools interact through physics, so the order of your actions changes how the ragdoll moves.

Object colors explain what you can do: tap red pieces to remove them, use movable blue pieces that cannot be destroyed, and account for the bounce from green surfaces. Gray objects stay fixed. Inspect the arrangement and decide which removable piece will start the movement you need.

pages.title: Box Puzzle
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Push boxes onto their destination spaces in Box Puzzle. Move the character with WASD or the mouse, lining up each push to solve the layout. The game records your steps and includes an undo option for revisiting a move. Consider where both the character and a box will end up before committing to the next push.

pages.title: Boom Room
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Gather diamonds while avoiding timed explosions in Boom Room. Jump and take cover around the bombs, waiting for them to explode before moving through the danger. Collecting more diamonds lets you unlock a character with a double jump. That extra leap makes higher diamonds reachable and provides another way to increase your points as you keep navigating the room.

pages.title: In Short
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Build word answers from a selection of letters in In Short. Read each quiz question, then click the proposed letters in order to spell your response. A correctly spelled answer takes you to the next level and a new question. If you cannot solve one, wait for the skip button to fill before using it to move on.

pages.title: Sea Plumber 2
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Rotate pipe sections to restore an underwater water supply in Sea Plumber 2. Connect the valves to the containers, creating continuous routes through the plumbing. All the pipes must fill with water to finish the level. Look at where each connection needs to lead as you turn the pieces, working across a board set against an ocean backdrop.

pages.title: Indian Challenger Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reconstruct motorcycle pictures in Indian Challenger Slide. Choose from three images of the Indian Challenger and three puzzle modes, then use the mouse to rearrange the sliding picture sections. Your task is to put the image back into its correct order.

pages.title: Ninja Runs 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Race other runners through bamboo courses in Ninja Runs 3D. Use the mouse to guide your ninja and choose a shorter route through the level to get ahead of the opponents. The contest centers on path selection as well as forward progress, so compare the available routes while working toward the finish.

pages.title: Baseball Crash
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Aim your baseball strikes at objects in Baseball Crash. Use the bat to send the ball into the targets and destroy them for points. Linking hits into combos can ignite the ball, helping you push the score higher. The challenge is to aim each strike so it contributes to a longer chain of destruction.

pages.title: City Taxi Driver Sim
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Work as a city cab driver in City Taxi Driver Sim. Drive through the streets, respond to passengers, and earn money toward another taxi. Multiple cars give you vehicles to work toward as the driving jobs continue. Use WASD to drive, Space to brake, and E to open the map while finding your way around the city.

pages.title: Restaurant.io
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Expand a restaurant across multiple floors in Restaurant.io. Use the mouse to build additional levels and hire managers for the restaurants and lifts. Growing upward adds more parts of the business to manage, with staffing decisions accompanying the new floors.

pages.title: Breakout Rush
pages.creator: Plug in Digital
pages.description: Keep the ball rebounding through bricks in Breakout Rush. Drag horizontally to move the paddle, lining it up with the ball's return to prevent a miss. The endless brick-breaking challenge tracks your score and best result as the action continues. Letting the ball pass the paddle ends the attempt, so keep following its rebounds while breaking a route upward.

pages.title: Trapdoor
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Follow the messages after Janie's car breaks down in Trapdoor. This story unfolds through a messenger-style conversation, using one-touch interaction to reveal what happens next. Read the chat as the situation develops, with animated images and emoticons included in the presentation.

pages.title: Frankenstein Adventures
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Collect stars and make your way to the chest in Frankenstein Adventures. Work past the hurdles along the route, using the mouse to control the action. The journey combines reaching the chest with gathering stars along the way, so watch how the obstacles sit between the collectibles and your destination.

pages.title: Toy Car Race
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Guide a miniature car around the tracks in Toy Car Race. Click or tap to change the car's position, collecting coins while keeping it away from wooden boxes. The same position changes help you line up with a coin or move clear of an obstacle. Watch the track ahead and time each switch around those two goals.

pages.title: Darts Club
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description:
Aim at the dartboard in Darts Club, choosing between 301 and Cricket. In 301, reduce a starting score of 301 to exactly zero, finishing with a dart in a double. Double and triple rings multiply the value of a hit.

Cricket uses the numbers 15 through 20 and the bull. Hit a number three times to close it, then score further points there until your opponent closes it too. Win by closing all the required targets and finishing ahead on points.

pages.title: GTA Puzzle Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Put GTA-themed pictures back together in GTA Puzzle Challenge. Each image offers easy, medium, and hard puzzle modes, letting you choose the arrangement you want to tackle. Fit the jigsaw pieces into place to complete the scene. There is no time limit, so you can compare the shapes and picture details without a countdown.

pages.title: Rescuers
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Catch people falling from a building in Rescuers. Two firefighters carry a rescue net across the street, and tapping reverses their direction. Time each turn to bring the net beneath the next person before they reach the ground. Successful catches add to your score, while the rescue becomes faster and people appear more frequently as you continue.

pages.title: EG Tornado .IO
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Control a moving storm in EG Tornado .IO. Swipe in the direction you want the tornado to travel, steering it away from the other tornadoes as you try to become a stronger storm. Watch their positions before changing course so you can keep your own tornado clear of trouble.

pages.title: Black Knight
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fight to keep an armored warrior alive in Black Knight. Approaching enemies threaten the knight, whose sword and shield are his tools for surviving the attack. Use the left and right keys, or touch the sides of the screen, to control the action. Keep responding to the attackers as the battle continues around him.

pages.title: Flip The Bottle
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Swipe to flip and land a bottle in Flip The Bottle. Flips earn coins that can unlock other bottle designs, including milk, ketchup, juice, and soft-drink containers. Keep landing bottles to build a higher score as the challenge increases. Distractions such as birds appear during play, adding another thing to watch while preparing the next flip.

pages.title: UNO Heroes
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Win card games to release captive superheroes in UNO Heroes. Your immediate goal is to empty your hand before the other players, with victories helping free more of the locked heroes. Remember to select the UNO button when you are about to play your second-to-last card. Keep working through matches to combine the card-table challenge with the superhero unlocks.

pages.title: Cartoon Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Put cartoon truck pictures back together in Cartoon Truck Jigsaw. Choose one of twelve illustrations, then select how many pieces you want to assemble: Easy uses 25, Medium has 49, and Hard divides the image into 100 pieces. Reconstruct the complete truck scene, returning to the same picture at another difficulty when you want a larger puzzle.

pages.title: Baby Beast Beauty
pages.creator: dreamgamestudio@gmail.com
pages.description: Clean and care for young zoo animals in Baby Beast Beauty. The animals include tiger and lion cubs, brown bears, and giant pandas that need washing after getting dirty. Give them a shower, then choose accessories such as glasses, necklaces, and headdresses. Feed the animal and finish by taking a photograph. Saved pictures can be viewed in the game's gallery, keeping the completed animal makeovers together.

pages.title: Neon Switch Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Bounce a colored ball through rotating obstacles in Neon Switch Online. Click or tap to jump, timing the ascent so the ball touches sections that match its current color. Contact with a different color ends the run. Collect stars for points and watch the color switches, which change the ball before the obstacles ahead. Keep checking the matching route as you climb.

pages.title: Princess Big Sale Rush
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Create three outfits for Jasmine in Princess Big Sale Rush. Join her shopping trip through a mall's sale event and browse the dresses, bags, and hairstyles available for her autumn wardrobe. Combine the choices into three different looks, changing the clothing and styling for each one. The activity centers on putting together Jasmine's finished outfits from the mall's fashion selection.

pages.title: Adam and Eve
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help Adam reach Paradise and meet Eve in Adam and Eve. Use the mouse or a finger to interact with objects in each scene, working out which actions let the journey continue. Look through the surroundings for something useful to select, then see how the scene responds. Each encounter is another puzzle between Adam and the destination he is trying to reach.

pages.title: Speed Racer
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Drive through a forest setting in Speed Racer. Collect roadside power-ups that extend your fuel, use turbo mode for faster racing, and gather coins to raise your score. Fuel pickups help keep the drive going, giving you more time to collect along the road. Balance the push for speed with reaching the pickups that support a longer run.

pages.title: 99 Balls Evo
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Aim a stream of shots at numbered targets in 99 Balls Evo. Slide the mouse or a finger to set up a shot and try to strike several objects during its path. Every hit reduces a target's number, and reaching zero clears it. Shots can rebound from the side walls, creating more opportunities to hit targets from another angle.

pages.title: Draculaura Swimsuits
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a beach outfit for Draculaura in Draculaura Swimsuits. Start by choosing a one-piece or two-piece swimsuit, then select its neckline, bottom, and pattern. Take her measurements and work through designing and sewing the pieces before she tries the creation on. Add bows or ruffles to the suit, style her hair, and choose sunglasses or a sun hat. Jewelry and heels complete the seaside look.
